identificationModule.briefTitle: The Efficacy and Safety of Oral Azacitidine Plus Best Supportive Care Versus Placebo and Best Supportive Care in Subjects With Red Blood Cell (RBC) Transfusion-Dependent Anemia and Thrombocytopenia Due to International Prognostic Scoring System (IPSS) Low Risk Myelodysplastic Syndrome (MDS)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Oral Azacitidine Plus Best Supportive Care Versus Placebo Plus Best Supportive Care in Subjects With Red Blood Cell Transfusion-dependent Anemia and Thrombocytopenia Due to IPSS Lower-risk Myelodysplastic Syndromes.

armGroups.label: Oral Azacitidine
armGroups.description: Arm 1: Oral azacitidine tablets 300 mg daily (QD) + best supportive care (BSC) on days 1 through 21 of each 28-day treatment cycle.

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Arm 2: Identically matching placebo tablets plus best supportive care on days 1 to 21 of each 28-day treatment cycle.

interventions.name: Oral Azacitidine
interventions.description: 300 mg daily, days 1 to 21 of each 28-day treatment cycle

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Identically matching placebo tablets on day 1 to 21 of each 28-day treatment cycle.

interventions.name: Best Supportiv Care (BSC)
interventions.description: BSC included and was not limited to packed RBC (packed red blood cell \[pRBC\] and whole blood), platelet transfusions (single donor or pooled donor), antibiotic, antiviral and/or antifungal therapy, nutritional support, and granulocyte colony stimulating factors (G-CSF) for participants who experienced neutropenic fever/infections.
